title: Word Search
constraints: board and word consist of lowercase and uppercase English letters
board is rectangular and each cell contains one letter.
inputFormat: Implement exist(board, word). Inputs below show JavaScript function arguments; there is no stdin parsing.
outputFormat: Return true if a path spells the entire word, otherwise false.
